Hyderabad, Telangana
  
Job Summary
  
  

As a Senior UI/UX Engineer for Tablets \& Large Screens, you will be UI/UX Visual Engineer of android application's most complex and powerful interfaces. You are a specialist who understands that designing for a 12\.9" tablet is fundamentally different from designing for a 6\.1" phone.
  
  

The mission is to translate complex workflows, dense data, and advanced functionality into an experience that is intuitive, powerful, and elegant. To go beyond simple responsive layouts to design for multi\-panel interfaces, high\-information\-density dashboards, and advanced inputs like keyboard, mouse, and trackpad.
  
  

A visual craftsperson obsessed with pixel\-perfect execution and a systems\-thinker who understands how a user in a "lean\-forward" productivity mindset expects to work.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Design Validation \& Auditing:** Conduct comprehensive, manual UI/UX inspection of Android apps ensuring strict adherence to design specifications, wireframes, and prototypes (e.g., in Figma/Sketch).
  
  

**Desktop\-Grade Interaction Design:** Design and specify the behavior of advanced interaction models. This is not just a "touch" interface. You must be an expert in:
  
  

**Pointer \& Mouse:** Design for hover states, custom pointer accessories (e.g., I\-beams, cursors), precision targeting, and right\-click/secondary\-click context menus.
  
  

**Keyboard:** Create intuitive and discoverable keyboard shortcuts for common actions. Ensure the entire application is navigable and operable via keyboard (Tabbing, Enter, Escape).
  
  

**Drag and Drop:** Define complex drag\-and\-drop interactions for tasks like file management, list reordering, and content insertion.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

5\+ years in UI/UX or product design, with a strong focus on complex desktop based applications or pro\-grade creative tools.
  
  

Deep practical knowledge of Android Material Design principles and patterns.
  
  

Expertise in UI/UX inspection, validation, and feedback on visual layouts, typography, spacing, and responsive behavior.
  
  

Proficiency in using professional design tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD) to inspect and measure design files.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

Experience designing for "pro" or creative applications (e.g., code editors, video/photo editors, 3D modeling, design tools).
  
  

Knowledge of platform\-specific features like Apple's Stage Manager or designing for ChromeOS.
  
  

Prototyping skills that demonstrate complex interactions (e.g., in Figma, Protopie, or Framer).
  
  

A basic understanding of front\-end technologies (HTML/CSS) and how responsive grids are implemented.

jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

Specialist, Infrastructure Engineering
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
The Portal Developer is responsible for maintaining the IT Automation portal design and code integrity, adhering to all standards and policies used within our company. They will assist other engineers and developers in the use of open protocols and platform APIs, along with automation vendor platforms, for supporting the design and development and integrating of IT solutions with the automation platform(s). Working with IT Automation and other Platform architects to maintain and evolve the Automation Reference Architecture. The role works with internal technical specialists, architects, and external service providers to support the future direction of IT Automation. The incumbent will support the implementation of IT Automation products and provide subject\-matter expertise to all IT Automation developers.
  
  

**What will you do in this role:**  

* Manage the design, procurement, installation, upgrading, operation, control, maintenance, and effective use of specific technology services.
* Follow standard approaches and established design patterns to create new designs for systems or system components. Apply agreed standards and tools to achieve a well\-engineered result.
* Carry out and also improve system software development and maintenance tasks by updating the product design to automate routine system administration tasks using standard tools and software development practices.
* Contribute to identification and prioritized adoption of Technology Engineering community practices within the products where you work.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and the Product manager.
* Participate in Product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with Product goals.


**What should you have:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3\-7 years of hands\-on experience.
* 5 years and above of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge or subject matter expertise withReactJS, TypeScript, NodeJS, and frameworks/systems (Git).
* Experience with software/application type monolith with NodeJS backend and AngularJS/ReactJS front end.
* Previous experience developing ServiceNow software solutions using JavaScript, Jelly, Web Services, MYSQL, XML, HTML and CSS.
* Proficiency with ServiceNow Flow Designer and development of workflows, custom web services, custom notifications, assessments, custom applications.
* Knowledge of building out ServiceNow CMS (ESS – Employee Self Service Portal).
* Strong knowledge of Agile delivery practice.
* Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL or other).
* Good communication skills.
* Flexibility to work a shift overlapping part of the US Work Day.
* Previous experience with the development of automated testing solutions.
* Working knowledge of AWS serverless architecture including the use of Lambdas and step functions.
* AWS or ServiceNow certifications are a plus.


**Preferred Skills:**  

**Primary Skills (Must have):**  

* Strong hands\-on experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
* Experience with Git and version control best practices.
* Experience in Full Stack Application Development.
* Working knowledge of Cloud Technologies (AWS preferred; Azure, GCP, or equivalent cloud platforms acceptable).
* Experience working with Databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, or similar.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Ability to design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain scalable web applications.
* Working knowledge of Automated Testing Solutions, such as Playwright.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in a global team environment.


**Secondary Skills (Nice to have):**  

* Experience with ServiceNow Development.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Flow Designer and workflow development.
* Experience building and supporting ServiceNow CMS / Employee Self\-Service (ESS) Portals.
* Experience developing custom applications, web services, notifications, and integrations within ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of AWS Serverless Architecture, including Lambda and Step Functions.
* AWS and/or ServiceNow certifications are an added advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your Opportunity**
--------------------



Are you passionate about building foundational technology that fuels the world’s digital innovation? At New Relic, we provide the leading unified data platform for all things observability – helping engineers, developers, and operators make decisions using data at every stage of the software lifecycle. Our New Relic Control team is at the heart of that mission, creating groundbreaking capabilities that orchestrate, manage, and optimize observability agents and telemetry pipelines at scale.

  



We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead a new strategic initiative within our Pipeline Control team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for defining vision, strategy, and roadmap for an enterprise\-grade solution that orchestrates observability pipelines to streamline telemetry data in flight. You'll collaborate closely with engineering and product design to solve complex challenges around instrumentation, configuration, and data management with new systems and experiences. If you love turning ambitious ideas into impactful enterprise products that delight customers, let's talk!


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* **Define and drive the product strategy** for our next\-generation observability pipelines solution and align your vision with broader company goals
* **Lead cross\-functional collaboration** with Engineering, Product Design, Sales, and Marketing to translate customer insights and technical opportunities into impactful product capabilities
* **Evangelize the product vision** internally and externally, providing thought leadership on how modern observability practices can transform DevOps efficiency and drive customer value
* **Engage deeply in technical design discussions** around distributed systems, client\-server architectures, cloud native stacks, OpenTelemetry, and advanced instrumentation workflows, leveraging your strong engineering or equivalent background
* **Steer end\-to\-end product development** from concept through launch, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery, continuous iteration, and measurable business success
* **Champion product excellence** by setting high standards for design, user experience, security, and performance while addressing complex enterprise needs at scale
* **Coach and influence** the broader product and engineering teams as a subject\-matter expert with clear priorities, measurable goals, and unwavering focus on customer success

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------


* **7\+ years of experience** in the Developer / DevOps / Software industry with 3\+ years as a software engineer or equivalent and 4\+ years in product management, with hands\-on software development or equivalent background
* **Proven track record of leading** complex, highly technical products through the full development lifecycle, ideally in an enterprise of B2B context
* **Deep understanding** of client\-server architectures (Linux, Windows), cloud\-native technologies (Kubernetes, containers, microservices), and modern software development practices
* **Familiarity with observability concepts** such as metrics, logs, traces, instrumentation, data pipelines, OpenTelemetry, and/or related platforms is a strong plus
* **Exceptional communication skills** with the ability to distill intricate engineering details into compelling product narratives for diverse audiences of both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders
* **Customer\-obsessed mindset**, always seeking ways to solve real\-world customer challenges and deliver the best possible user experience
* **Strong leadership and collaboration skills**, adept at influencing cross\-functional teams and aligning multiple stakeholders towards a common vision with clear, measurable outcomes
* **Passion for innovation** and an energy to navigate uncharted territory, a willingness to guide teams through ambiguous design phases, and a drive to shape the future of observability at scale

**Why You'll Love Working at New Relic**
----------------------------------------


* **Impactful Mission:** Join us in building the next wave of innovative observability solutions that empower teams worldwide with data to build better software, faster
* **Leading\-Edge Tech:** Work on forward\-thinking initiatives at the leading edge of modern observability, DevOps, and cloud\-native ecosystems
* **Collaborative Culture:** Thrive in an environment with talented colleagues with an inclusive, mission\-driven team that values growth, ownership, and continuous learning
* **Growth Opportunities:** Access to coaching, mentorship, skill development programs, career pathways, and the chance to lead a newly forming product area
* **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits:** Enjoy robust compensation, flexible work arrangements, generous time off, and more \- supporting you both personally and professionally
  

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

jobs.title: Senior User Experience Researcher, Google Ads
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in an applied Qualitative UX Research or a similar role.
* Experience with research methods (e.g., usability, studies, contextual inquiries, 1:1 interviews, unmoderated research studies).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human\-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or related fields.
* Experience with research methods (e.g., participatory research, conducting surveys, contextual inquiries, diary studies, unmoderated research studies).
* Experience analyzing user behavior in B2B contexts, enterprise software, CRM platforms, or support tooling.
* Expertise in utilizing AI technologies across the end\-to\-end research lifecycle from project scoping and study design to data analysis and reporting to drive efficiency and depth of insights.
* Ability to influence product decisions and strategy with insights and user data.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a researcher in Customer Engagement (CE) you will be an advocate for both the Google customer and our internal users who make great support experiences possible. Empower Google to intelligently engage customers and help them succeed at scale. You will focus on the customer empower Google’s customers and the Googlers who serve them. Focus on Ads and the Ads\-supported consumer space. You will bring transformational changes with AI Partner with ML/AI teams to reduce tedium and increase velocity, allowing users to focus on human\-only nuances and perspectives. You will drive broader adoption, resulting in a better understanding of Google’s customers which powers insightful suggestions and helps our customers achieve success.


This role works on a program that evaluates current AI experiences and sets the direction for both near\-term improvements and the long\-term goal for support experiences. Collecting and analyzing user behaviors, needs and challenges related to usage and AI experiences across a variety of products. Translate findings into compelling narratives and strategic recommendations that guide product prioritization and enhance AI model quality. Collaborate closely with fellow researchers, design, product manager, and engineering to build a holistic understanding of the user experience, integrating insights from multiple workstreams. Advocate a user\-informed approach to product development, ensuring user needs are at the forefront of our AI strategy.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Advocate for user centered product roadmaps influenced by user research.
* Lead the research agenda for critical workstreams, taking into account product mission, team priorities, and a global user base.
* Develop and provide leadership with a well\-founded point of view, tell compelling user stories and have experience leveraging and using AI tools for efficient data processing and analysis.
* Examine existing data and product designs to generate hypotheses and plans for high\-impact research. Identify meaningful patterns and correlate signals to provide coherent research insights.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, UX Designers, Product Managers, Engineers, and User experience researchers (UXR) partners to deliver impactful research. Also, work with business operations teams to ensure connection between UX and Business metrics.

jobs.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
 We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
   

  

 We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
 **Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the Role**
 The Product Owner owns the outcomes of a product area within Keyloop's core dealer management platform and its integration ecosystem: the systems that connect our platform to manufacturers, third parties, and other data sources. You'll work with an engineering team that combines deep platform expertise with delivery skill, turning integration and platform priorities into a backlog that keeps the ecosystem reliable and moving forward.
   

  

 This role suits someone comfortable with technical complexity and long\-lived systems. You won't need to be an engineer, but you'll need to be able to hold your own in a conversation about APIs, data contracts, and system dependencies.
   

  

 AI tooling is a growing and permanent part of how our Product and Engineering teams work, and this role is evolving with it. We expect Product Owners to grow into hands\-on AI\-building over time. This is a deliberate direction for the role, not a distant possibility, and we're looking for people who are genuinely ready and willing to make that journey, even if they're not there yet.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Track delivery and reliability metrics, and use them to prioritise fixes and improvements
* Manage dependencies and sequencing across multiple integration partners or workstreams

* Grow into hands\-on use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to prototype and validate ideas yourself, with structured training and time provided to get there

* Understand that this capability will become a core, evaluated part of the role over time, not an optional extra

* Solid understanding of Agile principles and the Product Owner role within Scaled Agile
* Proven ability to write clear, concise epics and user stories, including technical/integration\-facing ones
* Comfortable engaging with technical detail: can read an API spec or data model well enough to write meaningful acceptance criteria, without needing to write the code
* Strong communication skills, able to bridge technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to analyse data (including system/reliability metrics) and make prioritisation calls
* Comfortable using AI tools day\-to\-day to support product work (e.g. research, writing, analysis), plus a clear, genuine willingness to grow into hands\-on AI\-building (e.g. Claude Code) as this becomes a core part of the role. This is where the Product Owner role at Keyloop is deliberately heading. Candidates should be ready to commit to that development path, even if not yet hands\-on today


**Preferred**
* Experience owning backlog for a platform, integration, or infrastructure team (rather than a purely customer\-facing team)
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools
* Relevant certifications (e.g. CSPO, SAFe POPM)
* Experience with legacy system modernisation or working across old and new tech stacks simultaneously
* Understanding of automotive aftersales processes (e.g. service booking, workshop operations, repair order lifecycle) and how they depend on integration and platform reliability
* Existing hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to build or prototype software


**Development pathway**
 Growing into hands\-on AI\-building is an expected part of every Product Owner's development here. This isn't an exception process, it's the plan for everyone. We'll invest in structured training and dedicated time to help you get there. What matters on day one is genuine readiness and willingness to make that journey, not that you've already arrived.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. -----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google One is the way consumer AI is monetized at Google. It is a fast growing subscription based business with teams across Sydney, Bengaluru and Mountain View.


In this role, you will be looking after expansion, upgrades and cross\-selling, as well as personalization and promotions. Personalization and promotions drives the right message and the right offers to users at the right time and looks after the limited time offers and other campaigns we run to drive sign up uplift.


Expansion is all about driving storage subscribers to AI and making it easy and obvious how to grow the G1 subscription from a base plan to including YouTube and Home Premium.


Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client\-side (web and mobile), with server\-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Evolve the experience used by over 150m subscribers and own driving upgrades and growth via promotions and offers.
* Own the end\-to\-end product strategy for Google One's growth via upgrades and offers and how the team brings AI and the best of Google to all consumers.
* Be at the forefront of personalization and target to tailor the messaging Google delivers to all G1 customers across Gmail, Gemini and more.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end\-to\-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000\+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description** **Roles \& Responsibilities :**  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**


We are seeking a highly technical, execution\-driven Product Owner to champion our DevOps Practice.


In this role, you will bridge the gap between strategic business objectives and technical execution. You will not just manage a backlog; you will shape the future of our automated infrastructure, deployment workflows, and continuous integration ecosystems.


The ideal candidate possesses strong hands\-on foundational experience or deep practical knowledge of modern DevOps topologies, automated deployment strategies, configuration management tools (specifically Ansible), and multi\-cloud sync architectures. Equally critical are your soft skills: you must excel at Agile orchestration, high\-impact communication, and navigating complex stakeholder dynamics to align engineering capabilities with business value.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. DevOps Strategy \& Automated Deployments Advocacy**

* Serve as the domain expert driving the optimization of CI/CD pipelines, automated artifact deployments, and self\-healing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with tech leads to prioritize technical debt reduction, system architectural upgrades, and automated testing frameworks alongside feature delivery.
* Incorporate Ansible playbooks and automation patterns into standard deployment roadmaps to achieve immutable, predictable environment provisioning.

 **2\. Cloud Sync \& Multi\-Cloud Lifecycles**

* Define requirements for robust cloud sync mechanisms, cross\-region replication, state management, and high\-availability cloud storage/compute frameworks.
* Ensure product roadmaps account for data consistency, security boundaries, and continuous synchronization across hybridized or multi\-cloud environments.

 **3\. Product Vision \& Backlog Management (Agile Execution)**

* Own, prioritize, and maintain the DevOps practice product backlog, translating high\-level business capabilities into clear, actionable epic\- and story\-level technical requirements.
* Lead Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and release planning, ensuring engineering squads have an uninterrupted pipeline of well\-defined work.
* Define explicit Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done (DoD) tailored for infrastructure, pipeline components, and platform stability.

**4\. Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration**

* Act as the primary interface between core engineering, security compliance, business units, and executive leadership.
* Translate dense, complex engineering achievements or roadblocks into transparent, value\-oriented updates for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Foster a strong culture of collaboration across siloed operational and development teams, driving the developer\-experience (DevEx) feedback loop to continuously improve tools.

 **Qualifications**  

We are looking for a professional who balances practical technical capability with strong leadership and product management acumen.

**Technical Mastery \& Experience**

* **DevOps Practice:** Strong foundational or hands\-on experience in platform engineering, CI/CD pipeline structures (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), and system infrastructure.
* **Automated Deployments:** Practical grasp of deployment patterns (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling updates) and continuous delivery paradigms.
* **Ansible Expertise:** Direct experience writing or managing Ansible playbooks, roles, and modules for automated configuration management and orchestration.
* **Cloud Sync \& Infrastructure:** Good understanding of major cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with specialized focus on cloud synchronization, storage replicas, and networking configurations.

 **Leadership \& Soft Skills**

* **Agile Execution:** Proven track record acting as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager within a mature Scrum or Kanban framework.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated capability to manage diverse, conflicting


expectations from engineering teams, security officers, and business leaders.

* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to distill complex architectural concepts into clear, high\-level business narratives.
* **Collaboration \& Empathy:** A team\-first attitude with the cross\-functional leadership presence required to guide engineering squads without authoritative mandate.


**Experience:** 8 \- 10 years

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical industry experience.
* Any active Cloud Practitioner or DevOps Engineer certifications (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Red Hat Ansible) are a definitive plus.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) designation is highly advantageous.

jobs.title: Manager - Industry Intelligence & Benchmarking
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**


Meesho is India’s fastest\-growing internet commerce company, serving over 160 million customers.
As the competitive landscape in Indian e\-commerce intensifies, we’re investing in building a world\-
class strategic intelligence capability to sharpen how we allocate capital, set prices, plan long\-range
strategy, and respond to market shifts.
We’re looking for a founding leader to build this function from the ground up. You will be responsible
for developing the systems, methodologies, and team that give Meesho’s leadership a continuously
updated, outside\-in view of the competitive and market landscape — turning fragmented signals into
decision\-grade insight.

### **About the team**


This is a high\-visibility, high\-autonomy role. You will work directly with senior leadership and across
category, finance, and product teams. If you’ve spent years building expertise in market estimation,
data triangulation, and insight generation as a consultant or researcher, and you’re now ready to
own a function end\-to\-end inside a high\-growth company — this role was designed for you

### **What You’ll Do**


* Design and operationalize a multi\-source data collection and analysis framework covering the Indian e\-commerce and adjacent commerce landscape.
* Develop standardized methodologies for market estimation, competitive signal triangulation,and financial benchmarking.
* Create and maintain competitor economic models, including shadow P\&L estimation at category level, using published financials, market data, field inputs, and internal benchmarks.
* Establish structured tracking of international e\-commerce peers to identify playbooks,strategic patterns, and early indicators of market shifts relevant to India.
* Deliver decision\-grade competitive inputs to leadership across planning cycles, quarterly reviews, pricing decisions, and investor preparation.
* Build the connective tissue between external intelligence and internal decision\-making —designing output formats, cadences, and dissemination mechanisms that fit how the organization actually makes decisions.
* Synthesize complex, often ambiguous market signals into crisp, actionable briefs that executives can act on quickly.
* Own the external benchmarking dimension of strategic planning and long\-range forecasting.
### **Who You Are**


* 3\-6 years of professional experience, with a significant portion in market research,management consulting, or strategy roles where competitive analysis, market sizing, and financial estimation were core to your work.
* You have worked at strategy / market insights practice of a consulting firm (MBB, Kearney)or Nielsen, or comparable market intelligence You deeply understand how market data is collected, how estimates are constructed from incomplete inputs, and how to generate insights from ambiguous signals.
* Alternatively, you may have built this expertise in\-house at an e\-commerce, consumer internet, FMCG, or fintech company in a strategy, analytics, or market intelligence function.
* You understand P\&L construction and can think in financial terms — take rates, contribution margins, unit economics, cost structures. You are comfortable building financial models from first principles.
* You are ready to transition from advisory / research into an operator role where you own the function, build the team, and are accountable for outcomes.


### **Skills \& Strengths**


* Estimation \& triangulation:You can take multiple imperfect data points and converge on a defensible view. You know which sources to trust, which to cross\-reference, and which to discard.
* Insight generation:You tell decision\-makers what it means and what to do about it. You write crisp, structured briefs, not academic papers.
* Financial modelling:You are comfortable with scenario analysis, sensitivity testing, and building models that accommodate uncertainty.
* Stakeholder management:You can frame insights for executive audiences, build structured intake with cross\-functional teams, and manage external partners and agency relationships.
* Network:You bring (or can quickly build) an industry network — former colleagues, market consultants, industry contacts — that serves as a legitimate source of market intelligence.
* High agency — you thrive in ambiguity and can build something from nothing without waiting for perfect inputs or detailed instructions.
* Intellectual honesty — you frame outputs with explicit confidence levels, distinguish estimates from facts, and never oversell precision.
* Decision\-oriented — you measure your own success by whether your work changes a decision, not by the volume of analysis you produce.


### **About us**



Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e\-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.



We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state\-of\-the\-art tech infrastructure, and pan\-India logistics network through trusted third\-party partners.



Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi\-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e\-commerce ecosystem.

Our vision at Commutatus is '*To bring tomorrow closer to today*', and we aspire to achieve that for more than one client at a time.


Commutatus has recently partnered with Quantum Lead, a technology and strategy consulting firm, to enhance its technical expertise in Salesforce projects. Quantum Lead works extensively with leading designer brands and luxury retailers based in New York City, Milan, and Paris. We are building a team that will collaborate closely with senior architects from Quantum Lead to design and deploy Salesforce applications for US brands in the retail, consumer goods, and community sectors.


**What you would do at Commutatus \- You'll primarily work in a squad of 2\-4 people, comprising engineers and a project manager. Your responsibilities will include \-**


* Research and feasibility checks: Assist with feature ideation by providing input informed by research or your experience. You'll frequently advise the team on the feasibility of ideas and provide alternative approaches to meet the feature's objective.
* Planning and estimation: You will assist the squad in planning and estimating features to ensure that they roll out on time and function as expected.
* Software development: Understand the technical specifications and develop, customise, and maintain Salesforce Applications, including configuration, custom code (Apex), and Lightning components.
* Continuous improvement: Play an active role in team retrospective events by flagging problems and frustrations in the team, and offering solutions.
* Automation: Leverage Salesforce Process Builder, Workflow Rules, and Flows to automate business processes and enhance productivity.
* Quality Assurance: Perform testing, quality assurance, and debugging to ensure the reliability and performance of developed solutions.
* Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation for all customisations and configurations.
* User Training: Provide training and support to end users to ensure they can use Salesforce Service Cloud effectively.


What you need to have \- We are not big on credentials. A computer science degree or graduating from a prestigious university is not something we spend much time considering. We care about what you can do and how you do it, not how you got there.


**Absolute Requirements:**


* Hands\-on work experience with Salesforce, customisation of its capabilities, and best practices in configuring and optimising the platform for customer service and support.
* You should have strong technical skills in Salesforce development, including proficiency in Apex, Lightning Components, and other relevant technologies.
* You are open to working remotely with international teams
* You have exceptional communication skills.
* You are resourceful \- we don't expect you to have all the answers right away, but we want you to research and learn on the go to get the job done right.
* You can identify problems around you and propose solutions independently. We love independent problem\-solvers and encourage all our employees to suggest changes to streamline our processes.
* You are organised and structured. If your PRs are well\-structured, have excellent descriptions, and your JIRA/ClickUp tickets are always in the correct status, we want you!


**Skills and experiences we'd like to see**


* You've built scalable digital platforms before that have been successfully deployed in production environments.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Declarative, Programming, and Administration (develop code, Custom objects, Apex, Triggers, Reports, workflows, and assignment rules)
* Deep understanding of Salesforce APEX, SQL/SOQL, XML/JSON, LWC, JavaScript, SOAP, REST techniques, and Agentforce
* Experience working in a continuous development practice, including leveraging BitBucket Code Repositories, Merge Requests, Code Reviews, and Package\-based Deployments


**What we can give you**


* The freedom to learn and grow in the company.
* A supportive team that'll help you when you are stuck!
* A learning path, feedback, and resources to take you to the next step in your technical career! We even sponsor certifications and tickets to select tech events!
* A safe space to explore your varied interests.
* A platform to explore and understand different domains.
* An invested interest in your well\-being. All our employees benefit from generous health insurance and unlimited sick leave.
* The space for you to have a healthy work\-life balance.
* Transparency in the company's performance and financial status.


**Reality Check: These preliminary questions will help you determine whether you meet our requirements.**


* Do you love freedom and flexibility in your work?
* Do you seek out opportunities and learn something new each day?
* Are you a great communicator?
* Do you make an effort to ensure quality in everything you ship, so that you are proud to have your stamp on it?


If you align with everything we've said, we're interested!

**About Auric AI** 




 Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications
 



 Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error\-prone. Our mission is to use AI\-powered vision systems to detect and classify high\-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-moving defense technology startup, combining world\-class AI research with real\-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.
 



**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.
 



 This is not a traditional PM role. You will:
 


* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission\-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst\-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI\-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end\-to\-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.



**What You’ll Do** 



* Vision \& Roadmap


1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near\-term MVP delivery with long\-term platform growth.


* Workflow \& UX Design


1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst\-ready screens.
3. Use AI\-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.


* Feature Prioritization


1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must\-haves from nice\-to\-haves.
2. Make trade\-offs between speed\-to\-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.


* Execution \& Delivery


1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.


* User \& Stakeholder Engagement


1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.


* Metrics \& Success


1. Define and track success metrics: time\-to\-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.



**What We’re Looking For** 



* AI\-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non\-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world\-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company where AI meets national security.



 Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI\-native product builder who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
The AI Foundry delivers AI capabilities for internal productivity, working closely with all business units across the company to serve their needs.
  

  

As a Director of the AI software engineering group, you will lead the delivery of AI capabilities and applications from internal development teams and third parties. This role is heavily focused on executing and delivering AI software solutions on time, within budget and scope, and to the required quality standards. This role bridges partner execution, strategy, business needs, data science and operations to move AI solutions from concept to production.
  

  

You’ll partner with product managers, AI software engineers, and security teams to ship reliable, compliant solutions while building a strong development culture. Expect to influence strategy, provide leadership in execution, shape standards and deliver AI solutions that make an impact. If you’re unsure, apply.
**Job Description**
===================


This role requires an expert\-level grasp of trade\-offs involving delivery of Agentic AI solutions on Cloud infrastructure. You will develop and manage high\-performing engineers and organize a large group of contractors to deliver on scope, quality and time.


You will manage a growing group of full\-time employees and contractors focused on delivery. You will be responsible for researching and rolling out the latest technologies and methodologies adopted from industry\-wide practices to deliver software using AI techniques.


Provide day\-to\-day work direction for team members engaged in projects and delivery.

  

  

You will actively present leadership updates to GE Vernova executives and internal customers.  

  



You’ll work with others to define future technology rollout and architecture for products and services.

  

  

Quickly learn, internalize and develop a strong understanding of key priorities and how to map them to execution plans.  

  



You’ll be expected to align with stakeholders to ensure that data and process changes required in systems are implemented in accordance with project objectives and timelines.


Facilitate and coach software engineering teams on requirements estimation and work sizing.


Drive a continuous learning culture to help guide continuous improvements.


Provide leadership on Lean/Agile principles and development practices.

  

  

Utilize tools to track progress, identify key risk areas for specific implementations, and assist in resolving conflicting priorities through proactive communication with stakeholders about requirements and timelines.  



  

Operate as an engaged AI leader who serves as a subject matter expert and technical expert for assigned programs and development initiatives.  

  



Work with system leaders and functional teams to ensure products and services adhere to compliance and controllership standards.


The AI Foundry builds AI solutions behind GE Vernova’s internal AI productivity applications. We are the owners and advocates of internal AI usage within the company. We deliver our applications using the principles of responsible AI and drive the pace of innovation. We look across the company for reuse, break down technical barriers and drive collaboration with our business partners. We have a mandate to deliver bottom\-line impact, and this role is key to achieving that outcome.


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics), with significant experience.
* 15 years of experience in software engineering, with 8 years in a technical engineering, systems architecture, or principal\-level role.
* 5\+ years of experience leading and managing software engineering organizations.
* Cloud SaaS delivery experience
* Experience delivering commercial software products.
* Experience shipping AI applications with cost management.

**Education Qualification**


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics), with significant experience.


**Preferred Characteristics**


* Experience managing other engineering managers.
* Demonstrated ability to engage, influence, and collaborate with senior executive stakeholders (VPs, Directors) across multiple distinct business units.
* Proven track record of leading large, complex, cross\-functional engineering organizations with large groups of contractors in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment.
* Experience deploying RAG pipelines in production environments.
* Strong systems\-level thinking in decision\-making and problem\-solving.
* Experience working in global organizations.
* Experience with serverless technologies; including AWS AgentCore and Langchain.
* Experience working with AWS services and cloud platforms.
  

  

**Note:**
  

This Job Description is intended to provide a high\-level guide to the role. However, it is not intended to amend or otherwise restrict/expand the duties required from each individual employee as set out in their respective employment contract and/or as otherwise agreed between an employee and their manager.


**Additional Information**
==========================

At SCIEX, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

About the Role
 



 GoComet is one of the fastest\-growing AI\-powered supply chain platforms globally. Founded by four IITians in 2016, backed by $25M\+ in funding, and serving over 500 enterprise brands — including names like Unilever, Sun Pharma, Glenmark, and Lupin — we help the world's largest businesses run their global supply chains smarter.
 



 We're hiring a Senior Business Analyst to join the team that shapes how our enterprise clients get the most out of our platform — and influences how the product evolves based on what those clients actually need. The role sits at the intersection of consulting, product, and implementation, and is one of the highest\-leverage seats in the company.
 



  





 Key Details
 


* **Location:** 
 J P Nagar,Bangalore
* **Experience:** 
 4–6 years
* **Reports to:** 
 Lead BSA / Head of Implementation
* **Travel:** 
 Occasional, for high\-value client engagement



  





 What You'll Actually Do
 


* Work alongside our Customer Success team and our enterprise clients to understand each client's as\-is processes — their current workflows, pain points, and operational chaos — and design the to\-be process on the GoComet platform.
* Identify the right solution for each custom requirement (what's a clean fit, what's not, what can be standardized) and author Product Requirement Documents that engineering can build against cleanly.
* Drive the custom development lifecycle end\-to\-end — coordinating across engineering, QA, and Product through scoping, build, UAT, and go\-live — and spot patterns across clients that shape the core product roadmap.
* Solve real problems in supply chain tech with the Unilevers, Schneider Electrics, Sun Pharmas, and Tatas of the world — learn real\-world challenges by talking directly to customers and lead the solution to those challenges.



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



 You probably have:
 


* 4–6 years in one or more of: business analysis, implementation consulting, solutions consulting, professional services, technical product management, or management consulting.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, buildable solutions.
* Strong analytical depth — you can decompose a messy process, spot edge cases others miss, and reason through trade\-offs clearly.
* Comfort working alongside both client\-facing teams (CS) and engineering teams — able to translate between business and tech language fluently.
* Curiosity about supply chain, logistics, or enterprise operations (you don't need prior domain expertise — you do need to find the problem space interesting).



  





 Bonus, not required:
 


* Exposure to SaaS implementation, API\-based integrations, or workflow automation.
* Background in engineering, supply chain, or operations.
* Experience working with global enterprise clients across time zones.
* An MBA — useful, not required.



  





 Why GoComet?
 



 Enterprises Exposure
 



 You will get to work directly with Unilevers, Hondas and Tatas of the world and create direct impact.
 



 Pure Meritocracy
 



 At GoComet, growth is fueled by impact, not tenure. We operate a high\-performance environment where your promotion and rewards are directly tied to the value you create.
 



 Global Footprint
 



 You will design solutions for an international stage, working with diverse teams and clients across the globe, from New York to Singapore.
 



 True Ownership
 



 You are the "CEO" of the solution you design. Your decisions directly impact the supply chains of global giants.
 



 Elite Growth
 



 We are a high\-growth Series A company where performance is rewarded with rapid leadership opportunities.
 



 Complexity at Scale
 



 Solve the multi\-trillion\-dollar problem of global logistics fragmentation using AI and automation.
 



 Inclusive Excellence
 



 We are committed to diversity and equal opportunity. We believe that solving global problems requires a team that reflects the world's diversity, bringing together unique perspectives to drive innovation.
 



 Culture of Excellence
 



 We hire for mindset and character. You'll work alongside a team that values experimentation, transparency, and high\-velocity learning.

The professional spends time identifying the needs of customers and stakeholders, envisioning improved future states or business solutions. **Company Description**
**Eurofins Scientific** 
 is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
   

  

 The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.
   

  

 In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
   

  

 In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
